implementation.new_provider_discovery_capability: An additive explicit topic-query wrapper over Crossref Works v1. Existing Crossref tools only accept known DOI identifiers and return verification/reference projections; this wrapper accepts a public text query and discovers Crossref DOI records.

related_existing_blueprint.relationship: This optional provider adapter supports bounded source discovery for a future caller-defined research task; it does not implement or run the blueprint's ideation pipeline or authorize its separate research trial.

facts_used: The REST API exposes metadata deposited by Crossref members and trusted sources through JSON endpoints including /works.
The Works endpoint supports search and a limited field projection; some deposited abstracts may be copyrighted.
No sign-up is required for REST API use.
Crossref recommends explicitly specifying the REST API version; v1 is currently supported.
The wrapper pins its endpoint to /v1/works.
As of 2026-07-21, public-pool list/query requests are limited to one request per second and one concurrent request.
Crossref recommends checking response codes and x-rate-limit-limit, x-rate-limit-interval, and x-rate-limit-type headers.
Crossref documents rate limiting by email; this adapter sends no mailto and stays in the public pool.

public_pool_rate_boundary.global_rate_enforcement: Not enforced across processes; callers must coordinate their own use and stop on HTTP 429.

prior_art_comparison.existing_tool_query_contract: One to ten known DOI values with caller-provided title and year; not topic discovery.
prior_art_comparison.new_tool_delta: Default-off, bounded, metadata-only Crossref topic query with no account email or API key; this exposes a distinct input/task contract without claiming a new provider capability.

dependencies.permission_default: OFF; exact host route and per-invocation caller approval required

claim_ceiling: One Crossref response and its selected metadata at retrieval time only; no relevance, exhaustive recall, metadata correctness, source authenticity, article content, scientific support, or scientific validity is established.
